combo_label: At the Seaside × Birds & Birdwatching × Castles & Medieval Life

entries.clue: Dark diver perched on a harbour post, both wings held wide open to dry
Tiny brown scrap of a bird, tail cocked skyward, song absurdly loud for its size
Water-filled ditch that made scaling ladders useless and tunnelling a drowning risk
Slim projection at a wall's corner, housing a lookout or a spiral stair
Seawater basin among the boulders where children hunt crabs with a net.
Solid stone tooth of a battlement, sheltering a bowman between the gaps
Victorian walkway on iron legs, striding out over the water to a pavilion
Crisp ice-cream holder at the beach, or the little trumpet in a brass band.
Sheltered thicket or ledge where birds pack in shoulder to shoulder for the night
Pinkish woodland crow with a blue flash on the wing and a hoard of buried acorns
Noble sport of the hooded bird loosed from a gloved fist to stoop on its quarry
